name: 1v1 Me
author: seaplus
bootlegger: There are 2 players and 6 seats. At the start of each night, both players pick a seat different from last night.
Information from abilities are only shared with the player in the seat when the ability activates.
During the first 4 days, nominations only need 2 votes. On day 5, in private, each player picks a seat to die.
The Boffin and Demon are not aware a Boffin is in play.
The Demon is not aware a Marionette is in play.
